pendulum.title: Pendulum
photo: Include the suspension point, weight and a stationary reference in a full view.
Add a sequence or dated drawing and record string length, timing and nearby movement.

crystallization.title: Crystallization
photo: Include a full sample view and a focused microscope detail with magnification or scale.
Record ingredients, preparation, illumination and time since drying.

dice.title: Dice
photo: Photograph every die from above with its result unobstructed.
Number successive throws and keep the original order in the accompanying note.

coins.title: Coins
photo: Photograph the complete arrangement from above so each side is visible.
For I Ching, include all six line totals in bottom-to-top order.

grounds.title: Tea & coffee grounds
photo: Photograph the cup from above and from several sides in soft light; include the handle as an orientation reference.
Include the saucer separately and describe how the drink was prepared and the cup turned.

runes.title: Runes
photo: Show the entire layout with each rune in its drawn orientation.
State whether the set contains 16 or 24 runes and number their draw order.

cards.title: Cards
photo: Use one overhead photograph showing the complete spread in its original order.
Include card positions, deck name and any reversals; add a close detail if text is unreadable.

entropy-streams.title: Entropy streams
photo: Include one full view and one closer detail of the observation.
Describe the preparation, time, arrangement and question. Keep the original sequence visible.

handreading.title: Handreading / palmistry
photo: Photograph both palms with fingers relaxed and the full hand in view.
Add a sharp close view of the palm lines and indicate left/right and the dominant hand.

automatic-writing.title: Automatic writing
photo: Include one full view and one closer detail of the observation.
Describe the preparation, time, arrangement and question. Keep the original sequence visible.

automatic-painting.title: Automatic painting & drawing
photo: Include one full view and one closer detail of the observation.
Describe the preparation, time, arrangement and question. Keep the original sequence visible.

tracking.title: Tracking / tracks & signs
photo: Take a wide landscape view and a sharp overhead photograph of the trace with a ruler.
Add a side view, direction and location context without disturbing the track.

kinesthesia.title: Kinesthesia / body awareness
photo: Include one full view and one closer detail of the observation.
Describe the preparation, time, arrangement and question. Keep the original sequence visible.

radiesthesia.title: Radiesthesia / dowsing
photo: Include one full view and one closer detail of the observation.
Describe the preparation, time, arrangement and question. Keep the original sequence visible.

Describe the preparation, time, arrangement and question. Keep the original sequence visible.

photo: Include one full view and one closer detail of the observation.

lucid-dreaming.title: Lucid dreaming
photo: Include one full view and one closer detail of the observation.
Describe the preparation, time, arrangement and question. Keep the original sequence visible.

remote-viewing.title: Remote viewing
photo: Send an uncropped scan of the dated impressions, with personal identifiers covered.
Include the target identifier and reveal image separately, explaining when each was made.

precognition-presentiment.title: Precognition & presentiment
photo: Provide a readable image of the original dated entry.
Add a separate outcome record with its source and time; redact private information.

retrocognition.title: Retrocognition
photo: Send the dated original notes or drawing.
Include the archival reference and a permitted image of the comparison material.

telepathy.title: Telepathy
photo: Send the target list and receiver sheet as separate legible images.
Remove names, contact details and unrelated conversations from the record.

psychometry.title: Psychometry
photo: Photograph the whole object against a plain background and add a close view of its surface.
Send the impressions and provenance as separate records, with ownership details redacted.

clairaudience-clairsentience.title: Clairaudience & clairsentience
photo: Submit a dated transcription or drawing of the experience.
If sound is relevant, describe the recording and its context; a photograph cannot establish an unheard source.

oneiromancy.title: Oneiromancy
photo: Send a legible scan of the dream record or a drawing of its main scene.
Keep the original dream and the requested interpretation question clearly separated.

dream-incubation.title: Dream incubation
photo: Provide separate dated images of the intention and waking report.
A sketch is welcome; indicate which elements were recalled and which were added later.

hypnagogic-imagery.title: Hypnagogic imagery
photo: Send a drawing or dated written description of the recalled image.
Identify it as a sleep-onset record and omit unrelated private details.

dream-yoga-yoga-nidra.title: Dream yoga & yoga nidra
photo: Send the session notes or a drawing, with a reference to the teaching used.
Include only personally shareable material, not restricted ritual instructions or other participants.

mirror-gazing.title: Catoptromancy / mirror gazing
photo: Photograph the mirror with its edges and surrounding light visible.
Add one image from the viewing angle; avoid including bystanders or private reflections.

hydromancy.title: Hydromancy
photo: Include an overview showing the vessel or shoreline and a close view of the water.
State whether the water was still or moving and record the viewing direction and light.

lecanomancy.title: Lecanomancy
photo: Take an overhead image including the full basin rim.
Add a side view showing lighting, depth and any material on the surface.

pyromancy.title: Pyromancy
photo: Provide an overview of the existing setup and a focused flame image from a fixed distance.
Use a short sequence if the interpretation concerns motion rather than a single shape.

capnomancy.title: Capnomancy
photo: Use a contrasting background and include enough of the source to explain the plume.
Send a sequence or time marks when a changing shape is the subject.

ceromancy.title: Ceromancy
photo: Photograph the complete cooled form from above with a scale marker.
Add a side view and a shadow image, keeping orientation consistent.

lithomancy.title: Lithomancy
photo: Take a straight overhead image showing every stone and the boundary of the layout.
Add a scale marker and a key identifying colors or marks that may be unclear.

sand-readings.title: Sand readings / psammomancy
photo: Use angled light to show relief and include the full marked area.
Add a close image and indicate which direction is the top of the record.

inkblot-readings.title: Inkblot & incidental-image readings
photo: Send a sharp, unfiltered overview with the paper edges or a scale reference visible.
Provide any rotated interpretation as a separate image and retain the original orientation.

geomancy.title: Geomancy
photo: Photograph the complete chart with every dot clear.
Include the raw mark sequence and the source or legend used to derive the figures.

bibliomancy-stichomancy.title: Bibliomancy & stichomancy
photo: Send a focused image of the passage with page number visible.
Include the title and edition, or a short transcription if reproduction is restricted.

numerology-arithmancy.title: Numerology / arithmancy
photo: Provide a legible calculation sheet showing every step.
Use initials or a chosen example when full names or birth dates are unnecessary.

gematria-isopsephy.title: Gematria & isopsephy
photo: Send the original text and a legible table of letter values.
Include the manuscript or edition reference and indicate any uncertain characters.

onomancy.title: Onomancy
photo: Send a clear written example and the correspondence table or source.
Use an alias or initials if the question does not require a private legal name.

kledonomancy.title: Kledonomancy
photo: Submit a dated transcription with the context summarized.
Exclude private conversations and identify quotations only when permission or publication allows it.

cleromancy.title: Cleromancy / casting lots
photo: Photograph the full cast before moving any token.
Include the token legend, order and any direction or boundary used in the reading.

belomancy.title: Belomancy
photo: Submit a permitted archive image or a diagram of the described arrangement.
Include the source citation and readable labels rather than staging an arrow discharge.

ifa-diloggun.title: Ifa, diloggun & named casting systems
photo: Send only personally shareable images with the full arrangement and its orientation visible.
Include the practitioner’s explanation or source with permission, and avoid private ritual or participant details.

physiognomy-metoposcopy.title: Physiognomy & metoposcopy
photo: Use a permitted image of the historical page with its caption and page number.
Provide a close view of the diagram’s labels and its catalog reference.

graphology.title: Graphology
photo: Send a straight, evenly lit image of an original sample with its edges visible.
Remove signatures, addresses and private text unless essential to the submitted question.

movement-journals.title: Hand and body movement journals
photo: Use sequential drawings or still frames with a clear order.
Include the date, viewpoint and a short note about the sensations being described.

automatic-music.title: Automatic music & improvisation
photo: A score, waveform screenshot or photograph of the setup can accompany a recording description.
Include time marks for the passage and identify any edits or repeated takes.

guided-imagery-pathworking.title: Guided imagery & pathworking
photo: Submit a drawing or dated session note with the prompt cited.
Mark which images came from the script and which were personally experienced or added later.

labyrinth-walking.title: Labyrinth walking
photo: Show the overall path or a permitted plan with start and center labeled.
Add a short movement record without photographing other visitors without permission.

augury-ornithomancy.title: Augury / ornithomancy
photo: Use a distant overview and a sequence showing direction or behavior.
Include time, approximate location and species uncertainty without approaching or disturbing the animal.

animal-sign-readings.title: Alectryomancy, hippomancy & ichthyomancy
photo: Submit a permitted archive image or an undisturbed observation sequence.
Include the source and time; avoid staging behavior or handling animals for a reading.

nephomancy.title: Nephomancy
photo: Include a wide sky image with the horizon or a direction reference.
Send a short time sequence if the reading concerns a transformation in shape.

brontomancy.title: Brontomancy
photo: A permitted archive page or weather-log image is suitable.
For an existing recording, provide time marks and context rather than going outside to obtain storm footage.

scapulimancy-plastromancy.title: Scapulimancy & plastromancy
photo: Send a permitted museum or archive image with full credit and object number.
Include an overview and a detail of the relevant inscription or crack pattern.

extispicy-hepatoscopy.title: Extispicy / hepatoscopy
photo: Use a permitted image of a museum model, tablet or archive page.
Supply the accession number and a readable detail of the feature or text under discussion.

card-reading-systems.title: Tarot, Lenormand, Sibilla & playing-card systems
photo: Use an overhead view with every card readable and no cropped positions.
Mark the first card, orientation and draw order; add a close image for small card text.

astragalomancy.title: Astragalomancy
photo: Photograph the full cast overhead with each face visible.
Include a legend identifying pieces, values and the boundary of the cast.

rhabdomancy.title: Rhabdomancy & rod methods
photo: Show the full rod and grip from the side without obscuring the tips.
Add a plan of the trial area with the direction of movement and concealed target reveal kept separate.

astrology-branches.title: Horary, electional, natal & mundane astrology
photo: Export the whole chart with its settings and date visible.
Redact names and private birth details unless required for the submitted question.

astrocartography-planetary-hours.title: Astrocartography & planetary hours
photo: Send a map overview plus a close view with legend and coordinates.
For planetary hours, provide the full table and its sunrise, sunset and time-zone assumptions.

tasseography-variants.title: Tasseography variants
photo: Take one overhead view and several views around the inner wall with the handle location marked.
Use diffuse light, include the saucer if relevant and photograph before washing or moving the residue.

other.title: Other / a name or practice to identify
photo: Include a clear full view and a close detail.
Describe the material, place, preparation and question.
